shared_elements: schematic human figures in a row
justification: Both surfaces show rows of small, simplified human figures, but that is a near-universal motif; A is dominated by two large boats with upturned prows and hulls carrying crews of stick-figures, while B shows large standing figures in profile with raised arms, a bow, plants/offerings and smaller subordinate figures in an enclosed scene, with no boat at all. Beyond generic schematic humans there is no shared distinctive motif, relationship or compositional scheme, and the modes of depiction (outline linear silhouettes vs. modelled profile figures with detailed costume) differ markedly.
